selection_requirement: Each candidate contains substantive C++ and C# source in the same project.

size_metric.definition: Sum byte sizes of selected tracked Git blobs at the pinned commit. Bytes include whitespace, comments and source encoding. C++ headers count as source.
notes: Thresholds are project-specific, not an industry classification.
File count is supplementary; this is not SLOC, Git repository disk size, binary size or projected database size.
Explicit size exclusions do not authorize omitting necessary generated inputs/dependencies from builds or extraction coverage.

candidates.integration: C++ native hosting library uses .NET HostFXR and a C# managed assembly for loading, reflection and invocation.

exclude_notes: Tests, Example, build artifacts and build scripts are outside these selected source roots.
Coral.Managed/Source/Dummy.cpp is an excluded build placeholder.

prerequisites: C++17 compiler and SDK; Windows candidate uses VS2022 Desktop development with C++ and Windows SDK.
Pinned managed projects target net10.0: compatible .NET 10 SDK, runtime and native host pack.
For the CMake route, use CMake 3.25+ because Dotnet.cmake uses block(); declared top-level minimum alone is insufficient.
NuGet access for managed testing dependencies; native runtime files and managed assemblies must be staged for tests.

candidates.license: MIT repository license; retain additional BSD/LLVM notices on individual files.
candidates.integration: Own native C++ parser using Clang connects to C# AST, parser and binding-generation components through generated bindings.

exclude_notes: include/FastDelegates.h is third-party and outside the selected scope.
The listed generated files are excluded only from size classification; required generated bindings remain part of build/coverage accounting.

prerequisites: Proposed Windows x64 Release baseline: VS2022 Desktop development with C++, Windows SDK, C++/CLI support and MSBuild.exe on PATH.
Explicit net8.0 baseline requires suitable .NET SDK/runtime; this combination is proposed, not build-verified.
Git Bash, curl, archive tools including 7-Zip, NuGet/GitHub access.
Scripts download Premake 5.0.0-beta2 and matching LLVM dependencies.
